relations.note: Malinalxochitl is consistently described as Huitzilopochtli’s elder sister.
relations.source: Durán; Tovar; Crónica mexicana; Crónica Mexicayotl

relations.note: Huitzilopochtli directs the migrants to depart secretly while Malinalxochitl sleeps.
Malinalxochitl bears Copil after settling at Texcaltepec or Malinalco.
She educates Copil in resentment or charges him to avenge her abandonment.
Atzcatl Xochtzin is Copil’s daughter and therefore Malinalxochitl’s granddaughter.

relations.myth: Comparison of Huitzilopochtli’s hostile elder sisters
relations.note: León-Portilla and later retellings equate them through structural analogy, not early testimony.
Modern pantheon-building calls Malinalxochitl her daughter, but core narratives provide no parentage.
